subject: Integration sync request — GitHub app/webhook demo (technical deep dive)
messages:
From: Sam Ortega <sam.ortega@codewave.org>
To: demos@redwood.ai, hannah@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Interest in GitHub integration + request for demo

Hi team,

I signed up for Redwood's self-serve trial yesterday and am evaluating how the GitHub integration would fit into our open-source CI workflows. We're particularly interested in: webhook reliability (retries/backoff), permission scopes for the GitHub App, and running a small self-hosted webhook receiver behind a firewall.

Could we schedule a technical demo that covers the integration surface and any caveats for self-hosted setups? My timezone is PDT (Los Angeles). I can do Wed/Thu mornings this week.

Repo/context: https://github.com/codewave/runner-service (public)

Best,
Sam Ortega
Lead Platform Engineer — CodeWave Labs
--
Sam Ortega
sam.ortega@codewave.org

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-15T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interest in GitHub integration + request for demo

Hi Sam — thanks for signing up and for the repo link. Happy to run a technical demo. Two quick clarifying questions so we scope the call correctly:

1) Do you want a product-oriented overview (workflow + UX) or a deep technical session focused on webhook reliability, retries, and running the webhook receiver behind your firewall?
2) How many engineers will join (so we can bring the right folks)?

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Thu Jul 18 10:00–10:45
- Thu Jul 18 11:30–12:15
- Fri Jul 19 09:00–09:45

If you prefer any of those, I'll loop in our solutions engineer (Monica Patel) and your AE (Marissa) and send a calendar invite. I can also attach a short pre-call checklist to help us prepare.

Cheers,
Hannah
Sales Development Representative, Redwood Inference

hannah@redwood.ai
From: Sam Ortega <sam.ortega@codewave.org>

Date: 2028-07-15T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interest in GitHub integration + request for demo

Thanks Hannah — technical deep dive please. We'll have 2 engineers and our SRE join. The key agenda items: webhook retry semantics, idempotency keys, payload size limits, and whether Redwood's GitHub App can be scoped to a single repo instead of org-wide.

Thu Jul 18 at 11:30 (PDT) works best for us. If you can include notes on running the webhook receiver on a private subnet (NAT/egress requirements) that would be great.

I attached a brief doc with the specific endpoints we use (see link below) and our preferred observability stack.

Link: https://github.com/codewave/runner-service/blob/main/docs/webhook-design.md

Sam
